newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt overnight rates down, one-week rates narrow.
newsitem.headline: Egypt overnight rates down, one-week rates narrow.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound went down on Thursday, a day when the market is traditionally liquid before the weekend, bankers said.
The rates were 9-7/8 percent against Wednesday's 10 and 10 1/8 percent.
One-week rates narrowed to 10-3/16 percent versus Wednesday's range of 10 and 10-1/4, the bankers added. "I heard a dealing done at 10 1/4 percent," one banker said.
Public-sector banks also kept their minimum lending rate at 10-1/2 percent.
